blocks.text: Online safety ka matlab hai internet use karte waqt apni aur apni maloomat ki hifazat karna. Is mein yeh shamil hai ke aap kya share karte hain, kahan click karte hain aur apna data kaise rakhte hain, in sab mein ehtiyat karein. Talaba seekhte hain ke online kaam digital footprints (online qadmon ke nishan) chhorte hain jinhein track kiya ja sakta hai. Safety ki ahmiyat samajh kar users scams (dhoke), viruses aur cyber threats (online khatron) se bach sakte hain. Online hoshyar aur mohtat rehne se zaati aur school se mutaliq dono tarah ka data mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab "school_related" chhapti hai (beech mein underscore). Sahi likhawat "school-related" hai (hyphen ke saath), yani school se mutalliq data.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Khatron aur un se bachao ke tareeqon (preventive measures) ko samajhna cybercrime ka imkaan kam karta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Digital footprint (digital qadmon ke nishan) woh sab hai jo aap online chhorte hain: posts, comments, likes, searches aur tasveerein. Yeh mitti par qadmon ki tarah baad mein bhi dekhe ja sakte hain, is liye share karne se pehle sochein.

blocks.prompt: Online safety mein kin teen baaton mein ehtiyat shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Kya share karte hain, kahan click karte hain, aur apna data kaise store karte hain. Online actions digital footprints chhorte hain jo track ho sakte hain.

items: Online safety: internet par apni aur apni maloomat ki hifazat.
Scams, viruses aur cyber threats se bachao; zaati aur school ka data mehfooz.
